requirements.description: Execute one financial extraction from TSMC FY2023 consolidated cash-flow investing activities continuation table batch 10 to generate an independent candidate for cash purchases of property, plant and equipment, preserving TWD currency, original presentation scale, signed outflow source numerals, and all reported annual comparative periods.
